title: Each librarian action missing its required input is refused, says what is missing, and saves nothing
when: Registering a member with no name or no email, adding a tool with no name, returning a loan with no condition and reporting damage with no note.
then: Each gives 400 with a message naming what is missing. Afterwards the email is still free, the catalog is still empty, the loan is still active and the tool keeps its condition.

title: Each successful librarian action saves its record and shows it as stored
then: A registered member is shown with its ID and stored name and email, and its email cannot register again. An added tool, and a tool after damage is reported, are shown as stored. A returned loan is shown with its condition and note, cannot be returned again, and the tool reflects it.

title: A tool saved by a librarian action reads the same in the catalog
then: An added tool, and a tool after damage is reported, are shown exactly as the catalog then lists them.
